adds.rationale: Rocket Lab is a trading, liquid pure-play on the rockets/spacecraft wave and just delivered a concrete engineering milestone (Neutron redesign) plus a scientific mission win, making now a reasonable buildup-phase entry.

news_evidence.summary: Rocket Lab unveiled a revised Neutron medium-lift design at its investor day, raising first-stage engines from seven to nine and switching to oxygen-rich staged combustion.
Rocket Lab won a ~$190M deal to test hypersonic tech for the US military and revealed a privately funded Venus atmosphere probe aboard Electron.

removes.rationale: AAPL is the weakest-linked of the four AI-bucket incumbents to the AI thesis (no dedicated model/GPU story vs MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA) and now carries a fresh dated supply-chain headwind into its most important quarter; freeing this slot opens rockets/spacecraft exposure.

news_evidence.summary: Key Apple suppliers in China's Chengdu region were caught in fresh COVID lockdowns shortly after the iPhone 14 launch, raising production-disruption risk into the holiday quarter.

rationale_overall: The AI bucket shrinks from 4 to 3 (MSFT/GOOGL/NVDA) by dropping AAPL, the least AI-thesis-specific incumbent facing a fresh dated supply headwind, while the freed slot opens rockets/spacecraft via RKLB (listed pure-play that cleared a Neutron-design milestone and Venus-mission win this window). ITA (defense) and SMR (nuclear) kept: September Ukraine defense-aid actions support geopolitical, and NuScale's Q2 print reaffirmed commercialization. NVDA's China export curb (~$400M) is noted but not large enough to justify removal vs its AI-pure-play status. Watchlist stays at cap 6: MSFT, GOOGL, NVDA, ITA, SMR, RKLB.
